count_definition: PREREG sec 2.5, in the PREREG's own words. Contributing night (the floor unit, DP-21): 'a non-excluded in-window night carrying a legal sec 2.2 window label and >= 3 valid published picks, each with >= 5 valid matched controls, matured to t+60' (Q031 sec 2.5's series-B rule verbatim, maturity extended from t+20 to t+60). Ranking set (DECISIONS item 7, Correction 4): 'the set of nights that are sec 2.5 contributing nights and on which each of the nine objectives independently carries >= 3 valid published picks, each with >= 5 valid matched controls, after that objective's own exclusions are applied' -- O4 after the wrong-side-swing-stop screen, O5 and O8 after the complete six-level-ladder requirement, every objective after the shared sec 2.4 screens; 'the ranking set is a subset of the contributing nights by construction.' Sec 5.1 floors (none waived): 'An objective row may be reported affirmatively only with >= 80 contributing nights on the ranking set' (per-row, DP-21); 'A window enters the stability test only with >= 20 contributing nights' (cell floor, per each of the four sec 2.2 windows: two calendar halves and two arms -- platform-label always, bar-only tape if the SPY history is delivered); '>= 3 valid picks per night, each with >= 5 valid matched controls' is intrinsic to the contributing-night rule itself; '>= 30 contributing nights after the lock commit' (DP-24) is satisfied by construction (every contributing night is post-lock) but not invoked, because PROSPECTIVELY_CONFIRMED is declined in every branch (sec 1, sec 8).
